messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed Python SDK is logging full request bodies at DEBUG, Go SDK redacts them. Possible parity bug with our OTEL hook?

alex: ugh. can you repro in the sampleapp? which fields are leaking?

maria: repro in sampleapp (node + python). repro steps: run `REQ_ID=foo make run-sampleapp`, call /generate with prompt containing email. Python logs: `payload={\"email\": \"alice@example.com\"}` in DEBUG. Go shows `payload={REDACTED}`.

priya: that sounds like our redaction filter isn't wired into the Python logger when OTEL hooks are enabled. We recently changed init order in sdk v0.18.0.

ben: @priya good catch. is this only with OTEL auto-instrumentation enabled?

maria: yes — if OTEL env var OFF it redacts correctly. With OTEL_AUTO_ENABLED=true, python shows raw, go unaffected.

telemetry-bot: [alert] New telemetry error pattern: missing request_id on retry. sampleapp:req=foo-123 retry=1

alex: missing req_id on retry is my nightmare. do we propagate via context across async retries?

priya: we have two leaky places: (1) the redaction filter is registered on the root logger only when `sdk.init()` runs before OTEL init, (2) our retry wrapper recreates a new request context and doesn't copy the req_id metadata if OTEL traceparent present.

maria: minimal repro snippet (python):
```python
from redwood import SDK
sdk = SDK()  # OTEL auto-inits after this in our sampleapp
sdk.client.generate({"prompt": "hi", "user_email": "alice@example.com"})
```

maria: I attached a small patch that registers the redaction filter as an OTEL span processor fallback. but it feels hacky.

ben: can you open a PR? label it `bug/telemetry-parity` and link the sampleapp repro. I'll help with tests.

maria: PR #3421 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3421 — adds: register_redaction_on_otel_init(), preserve_reqid_in_retry().

alex: quick review: the tests need to validate that DEBUG logs never include emails even when OTEL_AUTO_ENABLED=true. also add integration test that retries keep same req_id header.

priya: I'll add unit + e2e sampleapp job. small note: make sure to handle case where customers supply their own OTEL SDK — we shouldn't double-register processors.

maria: updated PR per comments. added idempotent guard and test. cc @dev-tools for CI flake check.

dev-tools: CI noticed a sporadic failure in `telemetry_integration/test_retry_reqid` on windows runners. past flake was timing-related; suggest increasing timeout and using deterministic seed for async scheduler.

ben: :thumbsup: let's merge after green. this is blocking a few internal apps from turning on OTEL by default.

maria: thanks all. follow-up: can we add a small snippet in the onboarding docs showing how to opt into our redaction vs bring-your-own filters? new users keep hitting this and it costs them a support ticket.

priya: agreed — I'll add a short section under /docs/sdks/telemetry.md and a sampleapp env var.

alex: :shipit:
